fn willans(int n ? n >= 1) = 1
    += sum i from 1 to 2^n (
        define count sum j from 1 to i (
            = ((j-1)! + 1)/j
            *= pi
            >> cos
            ^= 2
            >> floor
        )
        = n/count
        >> floor
        ^= 1/n
        >> floor
    )
end
